name: Chief of Staff (Travis / vanlife)
tagline: Directs your other bots, and briefs you on any town you plan to sleep in
description: This one holds two jobs. It sits above the rest of your bots and routes work to whichever of them belongs on a task, and separately, name a town and it returns what somebody living out of a vehicle needs there: where sleeping in a van is tolerated, who turns up if it is not, what is on that week and the local mood.
author: Daily
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
